reader: CSV / TSV to XLSX conversion area
privacy: Your file stays in this browser. Nothing is uploaded.
drop: Drop a CSV or TSV file here
invalid: Choose a readable CSV or TSV file. Check the delimiter, text encoding, and quoted fields.
protected: This is a text-file converter. Encrypted workbooks cannot be imported.
unsupported: The data exceeds an XLSX format limit: 1,048,576 rows, 16,384 columns, or 32,767 characters in one cell.
resource: This workbook needs more memory than this browser can provide. Close other tabs or try another device.
engineUnavailable: The converter could not load. Check your connection and try again.
empty: This worksheet has no stored cell data.
previewNote: This window shows up to 20 rows and 8 columns. The download includes all imported rows and columns.
invalidAddress: Enter a cell address within this worksheet’s used range, such as A1.
preserved: Every field stays text, including leading-zero identifiers, long numbers, dates, and text beginning with =. Quoted fields, line breaks, empty fields, and blank rows are retained.
limitations: The download contains one worksheet named Sheet1. Numbers and dates are not inferred, and formulas are not evaluated. Inspect the preview before downloading.
previewLimits: Auto encoding reads UTF-8 or UTF-16 with a byte-order mark. Choose an encoding for other text files. A matching sep= line is treated as a delimiter directive and omitted. A final line ending ends the last record; shorter rows leave blank cells.
headerNote: Header mode keeps the first row exactly as written and adds spreadsheet filters. Duplicate and blank headings are preserved.
